methodology_boundaries: Preserve ATC codes, source labels, version dates, year, users, volume, DDD and expenditure fields without canonical medicine conversion in Bronze.
Preserve annual age/sex tables separately from rolling five-year tables.
Preserve Farmacie extramural Zvw data separately from Add-on intramural data because their sources and VAT treatment differ.
Do not sum user counts across medicine categories because the same insured person can appear in multiple categories.
evidence_limit: GIP utilisation and expenditure do not establish regulatory approval, reimbursement entitlement for an individual, clinical appropriateness, or medicine equivalence.
